name: sigill
description: Records each Codex session as verifiable agent evidence and seals it with Sigill. Prompts, tool arguments and results never leave your machine — only their SHA-256 digests are sealed.

interface.shortDescription: Verifiable evidence of every Codex session
interface.longDescription: Seals each step of a Codex session — tool calls, results, sub-agents and answers — as Agent Evidence Profiles v1, blind: only digests leave your machine. Sessions appear under Evidence in Sigill and verify offline.
